args.query: SELECT * FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'canonflow'
SELECT * FROM canonflow.projects FINAL WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6'
SELECT * FROM canonflow.canon_decisions WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6'
SELECT document_id, file_name, source_path, content_type FROM canonflow.source_documents WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6'

SELECT document_id, source_path, original_quality, quality_disposition, content_class, indexable, reason FROM canonflow.source_quality_dispositions WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6'
SELECT indexable, COUNT(*) FROM canonflow.source_pages WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6' GROUP BY indexable
SELECT indexable, COUNT(*) FROM canonflow.source_chunks WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6' GROUP BY indexable

SELECT source_path, page_number, sequence, chunk_id, content, document_id, locator FROM canonflow.source_chunks WHERE project_id = 'e8627781-5bf3-4c4d-905f-8dda49ab53d6' AND indexable = true ORDER BY source_path, page_number, sequence, chunk_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0
